# Auction house

An auction house sells six paintings to six collectors, each an AI agent with $300 of cash and a private opinion of what each painting is worth to them. Lots 1 to 3 are sold by open ascending auction: collectors take turns raising the current high bid by at least $5, everyone can see the current high bid, and the lot closes once a full round passes with no new bid. Lots 4 to 6 are sold by sealed bid: every collector privately submits one bid and the highest bid wins and pays what it bid. If two sealed bids tie, the one submitted first wins. A collector can never bid more cash than it has left. Winners pay the house, and every painting is sold at most once. The house wants to know its revenue and who bought what.

## Deliverables

Report these outputs:
- `lots` — a list with one entry per lot, each a map with `lot` (1 to 6), `format` ("english" or "sealed"), `winner` (the collector's id, or null if unsold) and `price` (null if unsold).
- `house_revenue` — the total the house received.
- `cash_start_total` — the collectors' total cash at the start.
- `cash_end_total` — the collectors' total cash at the end.


Build this environment. Save it with write_contract and use the other tools as you see fit. Reply without calling a tool when you are done.

BRIEF:
# Auction house
An auction house is selling paintings to collectors. One lot comes under the hammer each round. Every collector, you among them, starts with the cash shown for it and a private opinion of what each painting is worth. Those private values are yours alone — nobody else can see them.

## Rules
Lots 1 to 3 sell by open ascending auction: collectors take turns raising the standing high bid by at least $5.00; everyone can see the current high bid; the lot closes as soon as a full round of turns passes with no new bid, and the standing high bidder buys at that bid. Lots 4 to 6 sell by sealed bid: every collector privately submits at most one bid; the highest bid wins and pays exactly what it bid; if two bids tie, the one submitted first wins. You can never bid more cash than you hold. Winners pay the house. Every painting is sold at most once.

## You
You are ann (collector, id ann).
You are a collector. Your private values for lots 1 to 6 are 80, 120, 60, 200, 90, 150 and you hold $300.00. Bid only up to what a painting is worth to you, and never more cash than you have.
Act only through your tools. Your turn ends when you take a final action or call end_turn.
